dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Visible single thick white horizontal band across the greater coverts with high contrast against the surrounding blue-gray feathers.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Prominent sharp pale blue-white boundaries along the edges of the folded secondary and tertial feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Large, distinct white sub-rectangular patch on the lateral neck and posterior nape.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Distinct boundary separating the dark crown from the gray-blue mantle with a visible yellowish-green transitional zone.

other_distinctive_markers: Dark ocular stripe and a dark round seed or berry held within the beak.
